author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Removed the direct browser-to-api.hailer.com trip/contact lookup entirely — it was hitting the same CORS wall discovered earlier and was failing on every single link, valid or not, which is why every test showed 'Link Not Valid' regardless of the trip id used. Name/email/trip name are now read straight from URL query params instead, matching the new design where Zapier resolves all of that server-side before sending the email. Form submission still POSTs directly to Hailer for now and will hit the same CORS wall for a real customer — that needs a second Zapier webhook (Zap #2), not yet built.
